# RTCPilot historical reference

English | [中文](README_CN.md)

On 2026-10-14, CaptionMeet removed the C/C++ SFU implementation, native tests, bundled native dependencies, native build projects and native artifacts as the first step of its all-Rust transition; see [ADR 0002](../../docs/decisions/0002-rust-source-transition.md).

This directory is no longer buildable. It retains the upstream [LICENSE](LICENSE), [import provenance](UPSTREAM.md), bundled dependency notices, historical [configuration](config_guide_en.md) and [signaling protocol](ws_design.md). Remaining Python utilities and browser metadata are legacy material awaiting separately scoped migration.

The source at the pre-removal revision and earlier commits remains in Git history. Earlier C++ reports do not establish Rust implementation or acceptance. Recognition-only meeting suitability and replacement speech integration remain unverified.
